name: Netherlands
shortSummary: The Netherlands is a major hub for Indian outward investment and one of the largest sources of FDI into India, alongside growing cooperation on semiconductors and water management.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The Netherlands is among the top sources of FDI into India, partly reflecting its role as a European investment hub.
Dutch expertise supports Indian river and flood-management projects.

recentDevelopments.title: Semiconductor cooperation deepens
recentDevelopments.description: India and the Netherlands continued implementing their 2023 semiconductor supply-chain MoU, relevant given the Netherlands' role in chip-equipment manufacturing.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Positions the Netherlands as a growing technology partner alongside its established role as an investment hub.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership on Water
historicalEvents.description: India and the Netherlands deepen cooperation on water management and river-basin technology.

historicalEvents.title: Semiconductor Cooperation MoU
historicalEvents.description: India and the Netherlands sign an agreement to cooperate on semiconductor supply chains, given the Netherlands' role in chip-equipment manufacturing (ASML).

agreements.name: Semiconductor Supply Chain MoU
agreements.description: Framework for cooperation on semiconductor manufacturing equipment and supply chains.
